summary.text: Joshua Ayala is the Republican candidate for Arizona State Senate District 11 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Democrat Catherine H. Miranda.
He is a business executive who ran for the same seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Joshua Ayala was born in Phoenix, Arizona, and earned an associate degree from Brigham Young University-Idaho in 2019.
His career experience includes working as a business executive.
Ayala was the Republican nominee for Arizona State Senate District 11 in 2024, when he received 27.8 percent of the vote against Miranda in the general election.
He advanced from the Republican primary for the district on July 21, 2026.
